name: medication_dosage
title: Medication requests with their daily dose
description: Heart failure related drug prescriptions (MedicationRequest only) together with the dosage fields and the daily dose calculated from them, with the dosing start time shifted 1 day earlier so that prescriptions registered up to 1 day after discharge still fall inside the feature window

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: doseUnit
feature.title: Dose unit
feature.description: Unit of the amount of medication per dose (dosageInstruction.doseAndRate.doseQuantity.unit)

feature.name: frequency
feature.title: Frequency
feature.description: Number of times the dose is taken within the period (dosageInstruction.timing.repeat.frequency)

feature.name: period
feature.title: Period
feature.description: Length of the period in which the dose is taken frequency times (dosageInstruction.timing.repeat.period)

feature.name: periodUnit
feature.title: Period unit
feature.description: Unit of the period (dosageInstruction.timing.repeat.periodUnit): s | min | h | d | wk | mo | a

feature.name: dailyDose
feature.title: Daily dose
feature.description: Daily dose calculated as dose × frequency / (period × days in periodUnit), where days in periodUnit is h = 1/24, d = 1, wk = 7, mo = 30, a = 365. Missing frequency and period are taken as 1 and a missing periodUnit as d. Not calculated when the dose is missing or the periodUnit is not one of h, d, wk, mo, a. Expressed in the unit of the dose (doseUnit).

feature.name: joinTime
feature.title: MedicationRequest start time shifted 1 day earlier
feature.description: The MedicationRequest start time shifted 1 day earlier. Used as the event time of this feature group so that records registered up to 1 day after the reference time point still fall inside the feature window. This is not the real time - use startTime for that.

feature.name: joinEndTime
feature.title: MedicationRequest end time shifted 1 day earlier
feature.description: The MedicationRequest end time shifted 1 day earlier, so that it stays consistent with joinTime. Used as the event time end of this feature group. This is not the real time - use endTime for that.
